concepts.name: Note
concepts.description: A short throwaway test note with a title (1-200 characters) and body text (1-2000 characters), both trimmed and required. Any signed-in user can create, list (newest first by creation time), edit, and delete any note; there is no per-user ownership. Created and last-updated timestamps are recorded by the database. Not for real business, patient, or customer data.

concepts.name: App user role
concepts.description: Role assignment for a platform-authenticated person: admin or viewer. Users not listed default to viewer. Admins may use the product catalog, save product descriptions, and manage users; everyone can use notes. The project owner is seeded as the first admin; the last admin cannot be demoted or removed.

concepts.name: Catalog object coverage
concepts.description: Per Salesforce object result of the last sync: synced, empty (readable, zero records), not_mapped (readable, not shown), not_available (not in org), blocked (no read permission or query rejected), error, or never_synced, with Salesforce and cached counts and fields missing from describe. UI sections depending on a blocked object show as unavailable rather than empty.

concepts.name: Catalog sync
concepts.description: Admin-triggered, browser-driven sync of all catalog objects into the cache. 'Sync changes' reads records changed since the last successful run (SystemModstamp, 5-minute overlap); 'Full refresh' re-reads everything and removes records no longer returned by Salesforce. Read-only against Salesforce.

concepts.name: Product description update
concepts.description: The only Salesforce write: one confirmed Product2.Description change for an exact 18-character Product2 Id. Admin-only. Live read and describe verify the field is updateable and within 4000 characters; the request must carry confirm=true and the LastModifiedDate the user reviewed; a mismatch returns 409 without writing, and the PATCH uses If-Unmodified-Since so Salesforce rejects races. The saved value is re-read and verified, then the cache row is refreshed. Blank text clears the description.
